title: World Info supports character filters but manual maintenance is burdensome
symptom: The official World Info editor allows inclusion/exclusion character lists, but group history remains globally shared in default group-chat modes.
user_impact: Users may need to keep updating knowledge visibility by hand, and character filtering alone does not hide past group messages.

steps: Use World Info Character Filter for lore entries; use presence-aware context extensions when per-message event visibility is essential.

remaining_question: How much manual work do roleplayers spend updating character knowledge after long or branched sessions?
verification_plan: Compare manual World Info filtering with Presence/DMM on a synthetic story; record correction clicks and secret leaks.
